entries.title: Remove reviewers in bulk from Awards rounds and assignments
entries.summary: Awards now supports bulk reviewer removal in three places: the **Round Reviewers** tab gains a **Remove by tag** button and row checkboxes with a **Remove from round** action bar; the **Assign Reviewers** page gains **Select all shown**, **Invert**, **Clear**, and **Remove** controls that preview and then remove only open assignments for the chosen scope. A dry-run preview shows who will be removed, who will be kept, and why before any change is made.

where.path: Awards → [Program] → Rounds → [Round] → Reviewers (Remove by tag / row checkboxes); Awards → [Program] → Rounds → [Round] → Assign Reviewers (Select all / Invert / Clear / Remove)

entries.use_case: When a reviewer group is no longer needed for a round — or a whole tagged cohort was added by mistake — an admin can remove them all at once instead of one by one, and see exactly who will be affected before confirming.

cs_action.note: The new bulk-remove actions are gated on the API route from lennd/sessionboard-web-api#5192; they are hidden (404 probe) until that API is released. Confirm the API is live before telling customers the feature is available.

internal.when_to_bring_up: When a customer complains about removing reviewers one at a time from a round, or when they need to swap out a tagged cohort mid-cycle.
internal.who_should_get_it: Awards add-on customers running multi-round programs with large reviewer panels.
internal.staff_path: Awards → [Program] → Rounds → [Round] → Reviewers → Remove by tag / row checkboxes
internal.gotchas: Bulk remove on Assign Reviewers only removes open (unscored) assignments; completed assignments are kept. The Remove action is disabled for By condition assignment mode. Feature is hidden until the API route is released — do not promise it until confirmed live.
internal.talk_track: You can now remove a whole tagged group from a round in one step, or check off individual reviewers and remove them together — you'll see a preview of exactly who comes off and who stays before anything changes.

draft.docs_gap: The guide should add a section covering bulk removal of reviewers from rounds (by tag and by selection) and bulk removal of open assignments from the Assign Reviewers page, including the dry-run preview behaviour.
draft.why_use_it: Awards lets you manage large reviewer panels across multiple rounds and submission categories. Bulk removal tools let you clean up a round's roster by tag or by hand-picked selection, with a dry-run preview that shows who will be removed, who will be kept, and the reason — so you stay in control of who scores which submissions without tedious one-at-a-time edits.

entries.title: Bulk-remove reviewers and open assignments from an Awards round
entries.summary: Program managers can now remove several reviewers from an Awards round at once, by selecting them or by tag, and separately remove the open (unscored) assignments of the reviewers they pick on **Assign**. Reviewers who have already saved a score or declined a submission are kept and listed with the reason; other rounds are not affected. In **My Reviews**, reviewers no longer see an Interest Form review round where they have nothing assigned once assignments have gone out.

where.path: Awards → program → round → Reviewers (Remove by tag, Remove from round); Awards → program → round → Assign → Remove from these submissions

entries.use_case: When a reviewer is no longer available or was added to the wrong round, a program manager can remove them — and clear their unscored assignments — in one bulk action instead of one by one, without disturbing any work already submitted or other rounds.

cs_action.note: Nothing to turn on. The entry waits for both the API (web-api#5192) and the controls (web-ui-v2#1502) to reach production; the controls stay hidden until the API answers.

internal.when_to_bring_up: When a customer has added reviewers to an Awards round in bulk and now needs to remove a group — e.g. a tag-based committee that changed.
internal.who_should_get_it: Awards add-on customers running multi-round programs with large reviewer panels.
internal.staff_path: Awards → program → round → Reviewers → Remove by tag / select rows → Remove from round
internal.gotchas: Reviewers with any saved score or decline in the round are kept and listed with a reason; they have to be removed individually. Only the selected round is affected; other rounds are untouched. Tags must belong to the program. On Assign, Remove is disabled while step 1 is set to By condition.
internal.talk_track: If you need to swap out a whole committee from a round, you can now remove them by tag or selection in one step — anyone who already scored something stays, and you see the full list before confirming.

draft.docs_gap: The guide should add a section explaining how to bulk-remove reviewers from an Awards round by selection or tag, including the dry-run preview, which reviewers are kept (those with saved scores or declines), and how to bulk-remove open assignments separately.
draft.why_use_it: Awards review rounds often involve large panels that shift as programs evolve. Bulk reviewer management lets you keep each round's roster accurate without manual one-by-one edits, and the dry-run preview shows exactly who will be removed and who will be kept before you commit. Reviewers who have already scored or declined a submission are always preserved, so no completed work is lost.
